LanguageData.WI.DefaultRadius.Desc: Radius a new work table uses when it has no ingredient source selected. Pre-fills each bench's own fallback slider; changing it here does not alter benches already configured.
LanguageData.WI.OutputMode.Vanilla: Vanilla — each bill keeps its own store setting
LanguageData.WI.OutputMode.Vanilla.Desc: Finished products are stored using each bill's own setting (drop on floor / take to best stockpile / take to a specific stockpile). Default.
LanguageData.WI.OutputMode.Local: Drop at bench — crafter never hauls
LanguageData.WI.OutputMode.Local.Desc: When a bill completes, the crafter drops the product at the bench and immediately goes back to work; a hauler moves it to storage later. Overrides every bill's store setting at this bench.
LanguageData.WI.OutputComingSoon: More modes planned: Primary/Secondary (e.g. medkits → hospital, overflow to bulk) and Even distribution (top up all eligible stockpiles).
LanguageData.WI.StatusSourced: Sources selected: this bench pulls ingredients from the checked locations, map-wide. Each bill's own search radius is ignored.
LanguageData.WI.StatusRadius: No source selected: this bench uses the fallback radius below for every bill, overriding each bill's own search radius.
LanguageData.WI.FallbackRadius: Fallback search radius (used when nothing is selected): {0}
